verdict.instruction: Odour check of every batch by the QC technician.
verdict.reason: The origin and purpose of the odour check are undocumented. Meeting minutes from 2016 explicitly state that nobody knows where the check comes from and no batch has been rejected for odour since 2005.

chain.claim: The odour check is part of the QP-02 batch QC release plan
The step was present in quality plans from 1994, 1996, 2003, and 2009
As of 2016, the origin of the step was unknown and no batch had been rejected for odour since 2005
